engineWork.name: Advanced Red Mantis Magic
engineWork.reason: Grants a 2nd/3rd/4th-rank Red Mantis spell slot at levels 6/8/10 plus spellbook additions. The Red Mantis archetype is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES (src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts) and no spellSlotBonus shape can express a level-gated per-rank unlock, so no slot ever appears.

engineWork.name: Advanced School Spell
engineWork.reason: focusPoolBonus:1 only. The wizard arcane-school subOptions in core.json already carry advancedFocusSpell (e.g. red-mantis-magic-school -> shroud-of-the-mantis), but build.ts ADV_SPELL only maps advanced/greater-bloodline and advanced/greater-revelation, so the wizard never receives the spell. One-line map addition.

engineWork.name: Archwizard's Might
engineWork.reason: Grants a SECOND 10th-rank slot. spellcasting.ts hardcodes slots[10]=1 at level 19+, and spellSlotBonus has no rank targeting ({perRank,exceptHighest,entryId}), so this level-20 feat currently does nothing.

engineWork.name: Basic Cathartic Spellcasting
engineWork.reason: cathartic-mage-dedication is NOT in CASTER_ARCHETYPES, so this feat unlocks no spell slots at all - the dedication only grants a cantrip via spellFilter. The archetype needs an entry (chosen tradition, cha key, repertoire) for the basic/expert/master progression to fire.

engineWork.name: Bloodline Perfection
engineWork.reason: Grants a SECOND 10th-rank slot; spellcasting.ts hardcodes a single slots[10]=1 and spellSlotBonus cannot target a specific rank, so the level-20 feat does nothing.

engineWork.name: Candle of Invocation
engineWork.reason: Grants two extra spell slots at half your highest rank to a divine caster of the matching deity during daily preparations. Only "uses" is present; spellSlotBonus ({perRank,exceptHighest,entryId}) cannot express "2 slots at half your highest rank" and the item is not in consumable-modes.json, so the benefit never reaches the sheet.

engineWork.name: Captivating Intensity
engineWork.reason: Adds one extra daily casting to every captivator innate spell (and a second casting of the Heightened Captivation spell). No field raises the usesPerDay of previously granted innate spells, so the feat is inert.

engineWork.name: Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting
engineWork.reason: Grants an additional halcyon cantrip and an additional 1st-rank halcyon spell, and widens halcyon selection to the divine/occult lists. The halcyon-speaker CASTER_ARCHETYPES entry has a fixed cantrip count and customUnlocks that this feat is not part of, so nothing is added.

engineWork.name: Conscious Spell Specialization
engineWork.reason: Four extra spell slots (1st–4th, plus 5th at 18th) usable only for conscious-mind-granted spells. spellSlotBonus only expresses {perRank, exceptHighest, entryId} — it cannot express a fixed rank set nor a content restriction, and the eligible spell list depends on the subclass, so no legal data field delivers it.

engineWork.name: Creed Magic
engineWork.reason: Two extra 2nd-rank 'creed' slots restricted to a named spell list (Resist Energy / See the Unseen / Sure Strike / Water Breathing), which grow to 3rd rank at 10th (+Haste, Heroism) and 4th at 14th (+Fly, Unfettered Movement). spellSlotBonus has no content restriction and no rank ladder, and innateSpells cannot express 'two slots, prepared daily from a growing list'.

engineWork.name: Domain Fluency
engineWork.reason: This feat grants the ADVANCED domain spell, but its `choice` is {kind:'domains'}, and build.ts:1481 resolves every domains-choice through DOMAIN_SPELLS (src/rules/domains.ts), which holds only INITIAL domain spells — so the character is handed the wrong spell (and, for an oracle who already took Domain Acumen on that domain, a duplicate).

engineWork.name: Elementally Infused
engineWork.reason: abilityBoosts and trainedLoreChoice are wired and `choice` records the elemental plane, but the at-will primal cantrip tied to that plane (Gale Blast / Scatter Scree / Ignition / Needle Darts / Spout / Root Reading) is never granted. Background supports only an UNCONDITIONAL innateSpells array, and build.ts resolves effectChoices for feats, heritages, class features, subclass options and items — never backgrounds.

engineWork.name: Exultant Blood Magic
engineWork.reason: 'Increase the spell slots you gain from the bloodrager archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank' delivers nothing: CASTER_ARCHETYPES['bloodrager-dedication'] is deliberately cantripsOnly with no ranked slots, so there is no entry for a spellSlotBonus to target and no entryId to name.

engineWork.name: Future Spell Learning
engineWork.reason: Adds seven named spells (Behold the Weave, Cast into Time, Haste, Loose Time's Arrow, Quicken Time, Slow, Stagnate Time) to your spell list / spellbook / repertoire. Nothing on the record does this and no field in the schema expresses 'expand the spell list you may prepare or learn from'.

engineWork.name: Hierophant's Power
engineWork.reason: Grants a SECOND 10th-rank spell slot on top of the druid capstone. spellSlotBonus only supports perRank across all ranks or exceptHighest; there is no way to add a slot at one specific rank, so this cannot be expressed with a legal field.

engineWork.name: Infinite Mind
engineWork.reason: The psychic capstone grants a 10th-rank spell slot, but psychicSlots() in src/rules/spellcasting.ts deliberately stops at rank 9 ('does NOT get a 10th-rank slot') and this feature carries no field, so a level-19 psychic never gets the slot. spellSlotBonus cannot target one rank.

engineWork.name: Loaner Spell
engineWork.reason: During daily preparations you gain the ability to cast one ally-prepared spell of up to 3rd rank once that day, using your class DC and class DC - 10 as the spell attack. Nothing on the record delivers this. It belongs to the daily-preparations lane (a re-pickable spell choice) and needs a cast-with-class-DC path, neither of which any legal field expresses.

engineWork.name: Magical Understudy
engineWork.reason: The eidolon gains the Cast a Spell activity and two innate cantrips of its tradition, and the record carries no fields at all - not even the recorded-only pick that its sibling Magical Adept ships. The eidolon's own spellcasting is not tracked by the engine, so the honest fix is a recorded 2-cantrip pick plus eidolon innate-spell support.

engineWork.name: Maker of Miracles
engineWork.reason: Grants a SECOND 10th-rank spell slot beyond the cleric capstone. spellSlotBonus can only add slots at every rank or exclude the top N ranks, so a single-rank slot addition has no legal field.

engineWork.name: Mind over Matter
engineWork.reason: Grants an additional 10th-rank spell slot to a psychic who has none from the slot table. spellSlotBonus cannot target one specific rank, so no legal field expresses it.

engineWork.name: Oracular Providence
engineWork.reason: A SECOND 10th-rank slot. SpellSlotBonus only exposes perRank/exceptHighest, which spread slots across every rank — there is no way to say 'one more slot at rank 10 only', so no legal field expresses this.

engineWork.name: Patron's Truth
engineWork.reason: A second 10th-rank slot. SpellSlotBonus has no per-rank targeting (only perRank/exceptHighest, which touch every rank), so no legal field expresses a single extra rank-10 slot.

engineWork.name: Perfect Encore
engineWork.reason: An additional 10th-rank spell slot; SpellSlotBonus cannot target one specific rank (perRank/exceptHighest apply across all castable ranks).

engineWork.name: Plane-Hopper Jotunborn
engineWork.reason: The cantrip is covered by effectChoices, but 'instead of Large, your size is Medium' is not. Jotunborn's ancestry size is 'large' and build.ts line 3051 only raises size ('SIZE_ORDER.indexOf(g.sizeOverride) > indexOf(size)'), so sizeOverride:'medium' would be silently ignored — a size LOWERING lane does not exist.

engineWork.name: Ring of Wizardry (Type I)
engineWork.reason: The record carries spellSlotBonus {"byRank":{"1":2}}, but SpellSlotBonus (src/rules/types.ts:358) only defines perRank/exceptHighest/entryId and build.ts:2548 never reads byRank — so it falls through to perRank=1 with no exceptHighest and adds +1 slot at EVERY rank instead of two 1st-rank slots. The byRank lane needs implementing (and it should be capped to arcane casters).

engineWork.name: Ring of Wizardry (Type II)
engineWork.reason: spellSlotBonus {"byRank":{"1":1,"2":2}} is ignored by the engine (no byRank branch in build.ts:2548); the ring instead grants +1 slot at every rank the character can cast.

engineWork.name: Ring of Wizardry (Type III)
engineWork.reason: Its spellSlotBonus byRank map (two 3rd-rank + one 2nd-rank) is never read; SpellSlotBonus has no per-rank lane, so the applied result is +1 slot at every rank.

engineWork.name: Ring of Wizardry (Type IV)
engineWork.reason: Its spellSlotBonus byRank map (two 4th-rank + one 3rd-rank) is never read; SpellSlotBonus has no per-rank lane, so the applied result is +1 slot at every rank.

engineWork.name: Shattered Sacrament
engineWork.reason: Grants a halcyon cantrip and a 1st-rank halcyon spell (extra spells KNOWN in the halcyon repertoire, which casterArchetypes.ts models as repertoire:true) and lets halcyon spells be cast as divine. No legal field adds repertoire spells to an archetype casting entry.

engineWork.name: Sin Reservoir
engineWork.reason: Grants one extra prepared slot per day at a rank the player chooses (up to two below the highest wizard rank). SpellSlotBonus only expresses per-rank grants (perRank/exceptHighest), so it cannot express one choose-the-rank slot, and nothing else delivers it.

engineWork.name: Snowcaster
engineWork.reason: "You gain the basic spellcasting benefits", but the Gelid Shard archetype has no entry in src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts, so its cantrips, spell slots and trained spell attack/DC never appear (expert-snowcasting and master-snowcasting are dead for the same reason).

engineWork.name: Staff Nexus
engineWork.reason: The thesis gives the wizard a makeshift staff holding one cantrip and one 1st-rank spell with a daily charge pool fed by expending spells (two at 8th, three at 16th). Nothing grants the item or the pool, and no data field grants an inventory item.

engineWork.name: True Channel Spell

Fix = add {prompt:'Choose a class feat', category:'class', maxLevel:'half', traits:['druid']} to FEAT_PICK_GRANTS, which needs two small engine additions in featPickGrants.ts/pickableFeats: a maxLevel mode 'half' (floor(level/2)) and per-take storage, since these feats are repeatable (maxTakable:null) while build.pickFeatChoices is keyed by feat id alone.

engineWork.name: Aiuvarin
engineWork.reason: Low-light vision IS modelled (senses:[low-light-vision]). Not modelled: "you gain the elf trait ... you can choose from aiuvarin and elf feats in addition to those from your ancestry" — e.g. round-ears/sociable/earned-glory (traits:["aiuvarin"]) can never be picked. src/rules/featSlots.ts:56 gates an ancestry-feat slot on f.traits.includes(build.ancestryId) alone and never consults the chosen heritage, so the widened feat pool this heritage grants is unreachable. Engine fix: eligibleFeatsForSlot must also accept feats carrying the heritage trait (and the heritage record needs a field listing the extra allowed traits).

engineWork.name: Azarketi Weapon Expertise
engineWork.reason: "Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in Crossbows, Hand Crossbows, Longspears, Spears, Tridents, and all azarketi weapons" is delivered by nothing. featGrantsAuto.ts has the trained half (azarketi-weapon-familiarity, line 47) and has the mirrorBestCategory expertise twin for every comparable ancestry (catfolk-, conrasu-, genie-, ghoran-, grippli-, hobgoblin-, kobold-, vanara-, vishkanya-weapon-expertise) — azarketi alone is absent. weaponFamiliarity is NOT a record field (0 feats in core.json carry it), so the fix is a registry line in featGrantsAuto.ts: "azarketi-weapon-expertise": { weaponFamiliarity: { weapons: ["crossbow","hand-crossbow","longspear","spear","trident","boarding-axe","gill-hook"], mirrorBestCategory: true } }

engineWork.name: Butterfly's Sting
engineWork.reason: "You gain the Sneak Attack class feature" — derive.ts:1073 emits the precision rider only when ownedFeatureIds() contains 'sneak-attack', and ownedFeatureIds (derive.ts:1025) is built solely from the class's own feature list, subclass variants and classChoices; no feat-grant path reaches it. Taking this archetype feat therefore adds nothing to any Strike. Also needs the archetype's non-scaling 1d6 (derive.ts scales by character level).

engineWork.name: Captain Dedication
engineWork.reason: featGrantsAuto.ts:63 covers only the Diplomacy/Intimidation training. The dedication also grants a Group Impression / Group Coercion pick and, more importantly, a novice dedicated follower minion — captain-dedication is absent from companionGrants.ts, so the follower never appears in the Companions tab. Needs a companionGrants entry plus a two-option feat pick (grantedFeatByChoice is Background-only, types.ts:601).

engineWork.name: Combat Flexibility
engineWork.reason: The 9th-level fighter feature hands you an 8th-or-lower fighter feat at every daily preparation, and the record carries no field at all — no choice, no registry entry, so the feat is never picked or applied. featPickGrants is keyed by granting FEAT id (build.pickFeatChoices), so a class feature needs the open daily-prep pick lane (as construct-eidolon uses for its evolution feat).

engineWork.name: Draconic Paragon
engineWork.reason: Nothing on the record (no fields at all) delivers any of the three upgrades. Two are real sheet changes: your jaws/claws/tail unarmed Strikes gain the deadly d6 trait, and each Dracomancer 1st/2nd-rank innate spell gains +1 use per day. There is no lane for adding a trait to an already-granted Strike or for incrementing another feat's innate-spell uses, and the branch that applies depends on which prerequisite feat you own.

engineWork.name: Dwarven Weapon Expertise
engineWork.reason: Grep of src/ finds no 'dwarven-weapon-expertise' or 'dwarven-weapon-familiarity' anywhere — not in featGrantsAuto, featGrants, featFeatGrants or the backfill, and core.json carries only level/category. A dwarf with this feat never gets expert-or-better in battle axes, picks, warhammers and dwarven weapons. The lane exists (featGrantsAuto weaponFamiliarity with mirrorBestCategory:true, as used for catfolk/conrasu/hobgoblin) but is registry-only — there is no weaponFamiliarity data field on any core.json feat.

engineWork.name: Elemental Overlap

It belongs in featPickGrants.ts (class category, traits ['impulse','composite'], maxLevel below the level taken) — a registry lane with no data-field equivalent.

engineWork.name: Elven Weapon Expertise

Longbows, composite longbows, longswords, rapiers, shortbows and elf weapons never mirror the class's expert-or-better weapon proficiency. Needs a featGrantsAuto weaponFamiliarity entry with mirrorBestCategory:true (registry-only lane).

engineWork.name: Evolution Feat
engineWork.reason: The summoner class lists evolution-feat at level 1, but core.json's summoner featProgression.class is [2,4,...,20] — there is no 1st-level class-feat slot, so a summoner is never offered the evolution feat the class grants at level 1. Needs a level-1 evolution-restricted class feat slot in the summoner's feat progression (a class-level structure, no per-record field).
